# Test fixtures (NOT project data)

Everything in this folder is **fictional** and exists only so the tests and
scripts can run before the real dataset is ready. "Univerzitet Lipa" and the
town of Brezovac are invented (same convention as the course lab repository).

- `make_fixtures.py` generates the files below (never edit them by hand)
- `exhibits/` holds two made-up exhibits in Bosnian and English
- `questions_val.csv` holds 22 made-up questions in the format of
  `data/questions/questions.csv`

Numbers produced from these files are smoke-test output. They are never
reported in the paper.
